title: Classic American Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish made with sausages, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of sweet and tangy flavors will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: kissed tangy
ingredients.notes: likely referring to a tangy BBQ sauce

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: a cast-iron or stainless steel skillet is recommended

instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced potato to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked sausages back to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
